cohort: Newborns hospitalized in the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) between 2010 and 2015 who had serum creatinine levels above 1 mg% and underwent at least two blood tests during their hospitalization.
finding: This study found underreporting of acute kidney injury (AKI), particularly in preterm newborns, and suggests different clinical profiles of AKI between preterm and term neonates, with later onset, milder, but recurrent episodes in preterm newborns.
gest_age: Preterm (mean gestational age: 28 +/- 3 weeks) and term (mean gestational age: 38.5 +/- 1 week)
birth_weight: Preterm (mean birth weight: 1002 +/- 57 grams) and term (mean birth weight: 3157 +/- 375 grams)
